name: peltdev-frontend-tests
description: Dev-only test tooling for the frontend SPA. The actual deployed frontend (index.html + app.js) needs no build step, no npm, and no dependencies at all - this package.json exists purely so test_harness.js can simulate a browser (via jsdom) and drive the real app.js against a running backend, catching regressions before you deploy. Never installed on GitHub Pages; nothing here ships.
